evidence_chain.link: The quote supports the diagnosis of infective endocarditis (B1) by mentioning the use of PET/CT and WBC scintigraphy for detecting abnormal activity around the prosthetic valve.
evidence_chain.quote: Abnormal activity around the prosthetic valve detected by fluoro-18-fluorodeoxyglucose ((18F)FDG) positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) or radiolabeled white blood cells (WBC) scintigraphy with single-photon emission computed tomography/computed tomography (SPECT/CT) is considered a major criterion for the diagnosis of IE according to ESC guidelines published in 2015.

evidence_chain.quote: Echocardiography is the first-line diagnostic tool and provides information on major Duke/ESC criteria.
